# Private Navigation Colour & Course at a Glance Alignment

**Scope:** Seven protected pages sharing `assets/scripts/private-navigation.js`, plus the course-at-a-glance summary generated by `assets/scripts/learning-catalog.js` on the public course tracks, including AI.

## Changes

- Updated the single maintained protected navigation skin (`assets/styles/private-workspace.css`) from white to a flat deep navy `#152841` with pale `#F2F6FF` navigation text, cooler blue section icons, and a subtle indigo `#2D426D` active-row surface with an amber `#F3B963` leading marker. Logo treatment, group captions, account identity and Sign out now remain readable on the dark sidebar.
- Updated the mobile private drawer's close button for white text and dark-blue control contrast. The protected-page content canvas is **still light**; only the navigation is dark. Navigation content, role-based visibility, sign-out behaviour, links and mobile drawer JavaScript are unchanged.
- Replaced the conflicting final course-summary styling block in `assets/styles/course-shared-responsiveness.css` with an aligned summary: uniform 18–32px inset padding, left-aligned eyebrow/title/description, correctly placed course-count label, separated progress/action row, no faux link buttons, and mobile single-column flow below 900px. This maintained rule applies consistently to all course tracks, including **AI Integration in Data Analysis**.
- Incremented the public service-worker cache identifier to refresh the changed styles after deployment.

## Verification

- Build, lint, and complete automated test suite pass.
- Dedicated regression test: `tests/private-nav-colour-course-glance.mjs`.
- Chromium preview using actual application CSS with representative markup and role simulation: private sidebar/drawer and AI summary at **360px, 768px, 1280px**. All six combinations avoid page-level horizontal overflow; navigation colours and active state and the summary's internal padding verified via computed styles.
- The screenshots are *layout previews*, not live database-authenticated production sessions. Check signed-in admin and learner data once deployed.
